question: What's the status of the Dev Health Agent Context Runtime (Context Fabric) project?

invariants.$comment_allowed_widening: Observed: scope_resolution_outcome='organization_fallback', allowed=['unresolved'] (receipt tests/acceptance/artifacts/wave4/subject-label.parenthetical-unquoted.json). CHAOS-3407's unquoted-parenthetical extraction gap means the label never commits, so preflight widens with disclosure. CHAOS-3490 Part 2 / CHAOS-3219 Phase 2 exit, run 7 (world digest 2e1e254d3ee8b799fd58234e865ccf1361c2753c412d1b526bf4e79d1e445232, wave_3_1 preflight enabled=True -- the first runs to measure the real CHAOS-3292 preflight path). The allowed list is WIDENED, not the expectation weakened: the profile keeps its honest primary expected_scope_resolution_outcome and this invariant additionally accepts organization_fallback, which is the DISCLOSED widening this invariant's own 'assert' prose already names as acceptable (\"widening is only ever a disclosed, terminal answered_with_gaps/needs_clarification outcome\"). Disclosure proved live, not assumed -- .p2exit-logs/probe-widening-acr.log and probe-widening-wordorder.log, run 61ba05f7-2d14-4d56-8cc3-b811000d9fa1, scope.resolved frame: outcome='organization_fallback', fallbacks=['organization'], resolved_scope.direct_scope='organization', answer terminal answered_with_gaps with subject_ref null and a direct_summary that never claims to have answered about the named subject. Production reaches it through subject_preflight.py:863 _organization_wide_result, whose DevScopeResolution is required by contracts.py:416-423 to carry organization scope -- a machine consumer reading dev_scope_resolution.v1 can see exactly what happened. A silent widen (org scope with outcome='exact' and no fallbacks) is still caught, because that is a different enum value and is not in this list.
invariants.assert: A named subject mention that misses its intended target never silently widens to org-wide/broader scope; widening is only ever a disclosed, terminal answered_with_gaps/needs_clarification outcome.
invariants.$comment: Wired to the real graduated checker scope_resolution_outcome_in against this case's own resolution-profile expected_scope_resolution_outcome (rebase pass, 2a landed the 3 graduated checkers in PR #1518) -- no longer a narrower no_internal_error placeholder.

invariants.assert: A run that widens scope must reach a DISCLOSED terminal -- the widening is never absorbed into a terminal that reads as an ordinary, subject-specific answer.
invariants.$comment: CHAOS-3490 Part 2, closing an adversarial-review finding (2026-08-07). scope_resolution_outcome_in checks only the outcome ENUM; this case's no-silent-widening assert prose additionally requires the widening to be DISCLOSED, and nothing asserted that half. The gap was real and narrow: before the allowed list was widened, ANY organization_fallback failed by accident (wrong enum); after widening, a run that genuinely widens but fails the disclosure half would have passed. Nothing structural closes it -- validate_outcome_consistency only checks frame self-consistency, and the CHAOS-3421 leak guard is a text heuristic. Wired via from_profile so the profile stays the single source of truth rather than a literal pair chosen here.

invariants.assert: No shape of subject label (parenthetical, >=5 words, typo, acronym, wrong word order) can crash the run to internal_error; worst case is a graceful terminal.
invariants.$comment: check=no_internal_error is a real, always-meaningful floor (the run must not crash to internal_error) but is NARROWER than this invariant's full 'assert' claim above -- Lane 2a's invariants.py registry (read directly, 2026-08-06) has no checker yet for the specific widening/unauthorized-candidate/persistence claim this category names. Tracked as a Lane 2a checker gap, not silently claimed as fully enforced.

invariants.assert: Every clarification or error terminal persists a real transcript row (DevAnswer or the CHAOS-3423 dev_error.v1 row) -- never a silently-dropped turn.
invariants.$comment: Wired to the real graduated checker terminal_persists_assistant_row (rebase pass, 2a landed the 3 graduated checkers in PR #1518) -- no longer a narrower no_internal_error placeholder.

invariants.assert: The run's derived wave4_case_result.v1 resolution_path equals this case's resolution-profiles/deterministic-v1.json entry's own resolution_path (null is a valid, asserted value for n/a-subject cases that never attempt mention resolution).

notes: CHAOS-3407 primary bug: question_interpreter.py's _NAME regex extracts ZERO typed mentions for an unquoted parenthetical-qualified label. CHAOS-3407 fix not yet landed (PAUSED per t-llm-matching.md) -- exact resolution is NOT asserted, only the two invariants (must not silently widen org-wide, must not internal_error).
$comment_principal_pool: CHAOS-3490: user_alias assigned by deterministic round-robin over the ordinary-primary pool (sorted case id, index 70 of 85). The pool is role-identical to primary.ordinary, so this changes request DISTRIBUTION only -- never what this case proves. Spreading exists because production caps one user at 20 requests/15min and 85 cases on one alias made a single-pass armed run impossible.
